{{Quote|When they reached the command staff, they took us as prisoners to their lead ship. There I was forced, on my knees, to explain my presence in the Trianii system and to apologize for our interference there.|[[Jiprin Kosh]]|<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
The '''Trian system''', also known as the '''Trianii system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trianii Space/Legends|Trianii Space]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trian/Legends|Trian]].
